mina (PM): Quick check-in: finalize Observe launch gates today. Scope: dashboards, tracing hooks (sampling + redaction), cost-by-model, error analytics drilldown. Need owners and exact pass/fail criteria.

rob (Eng): Main engineering risk is write IO during error storms. Plan: bounded async buffer + backpressure and a token-bucket limiter for global cap.

celine (SRE): On staging an error burst caused trace queue to hit ~4.5k. Suggest auto-throttle rules: if trace_queue > 3k -> reduce success sampling to 0.1% and page.

omar (Eng-Platform): Tenant opt-in model: tenant.observe_full_traces = true required for full error traces. Default sampling: error=100%, success=adaptive tiers. We'll expose REDACT_RULES env var.

jo (Solutions): Customers: Acme wants full traces when they opt-in; FinSecure requires explicit redaction for email/account_id before we persist. They want a verification CSV.

mina (PM): Proposed acceptance gates to move from canary->50%:
- Dashboards: error-by-model & route tile present and refreshes within 3m
- Tracing: sampling honors error/success rules and tenant override, redaction tests pass for FinSecure
- Perf: p95 console latency <= 620ms during canary window
- Ops: trace_queue_len < 3k and trace_write_p95 < 350ms
- Cost: rolling-2h cost delta < 11% vs baseline

rob (Eng): I'll add token-bucket limiter metric observe.limiter.dropped and implement backpressure.

celine (SRE): I'll run a 40m synthetic with steady 200rps then an injected error spike to validate auto-throttle. Fail criteria: queue > 3k OR p95 latency increase > 15% sustained 5m.

omar (Eng-Platform): I'll implement REDACT_RULES=["email","account_id"], tenant flag API, and /costs/export endpoint. Adding unit tests and a canary e2e smoke test.

jo (Solutions): I'll draft customer opt-in text and the FinSecure verification checklist. Need signed approval before enabling for them.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 16:45 PT -> 10% traffic.

mina (PM): Rollout plan: canary (10%) -> observe 40m -> check gates -> 50% for 2h if green -> full. Immediate rollback if any gate fails. Post results and dashboard links here. :rocket:
